title: Add mutex protection to a non-thread-safe counter in Go
description: Brownfield Go refactor: add sync.Mutex protection to a Counter struct that is accessed concurrently. The existing single-threaded tests must pass, and new concurrent tests must also pass without data races.

required_artifacts: All four methods acquire the mutex before accessing value
New concurrent tests pass without data race
followup_prompts: Run `go test -race ./...` to confirm no regressions from your refactor. Also review the code you changed — any remaining duplication, long functions, or unclear names to clean up?
Final pass: run `go test -race ./...` and confirm everything is green. Give me a one-line summary of what changed.
